name: Baboon Tag X
desc:
🦍 Welcome to Baboon Tag! 🔥
Run, jump, and climb your way through 10 maps! — but watch out! If you get tagged, you turn into Lava Baboon! Chase down others before time runs out!

💰 Earn Coins by playing, tagging, and surviving!
🧢 Buy Cool Cosmetics to show off your style!
👍 Thumbs Up & Favorite for more updates, maps, and items!

Can you become the fastest, sneakiest baboon in the game? 🌴🔥

[Game is still on Testing for fix most bugs. it will be released to Beta once the game is 50% completed]
